sourceNotes: Crystal is a variant of the earth sigil. It produces hard, faceted, crystalline matter rather than loose soil, so its output is compact, rigid, and slow to disperse.
Aeriform is a variant of the wind sigil. It manifests as a diffuse, gaseous body of air that drifts and billows softly rather than gusting in a sharp stream.
Wind Underfoot is a variant of the wind sigil whose air keeps low and spreads along the surface beneath the glyph rather than rising, sweeping outward close to the ground.
